reference_records.description_en: SLaDe translates function-level assembly into C with a 200M-parameter encoder–decoder model, code-specific tokenization and PsycheC type completion. It studies x86 and ARM at -O0 and -O3, combining generated candidates with input/output checks. The input is assembly text, not raw machine bytes; disassembly is outside the method.
reference_records.description_zh: SLaDe 使用 200M 参数的编码器—解码器模型、面向代码的分词及 PsycheC 类型补全，将函数级汇编转换为 C。研究覆盖 x86 与 ARM 的 -O0、-O3 设置，并结合生成候选与输入／输出检查。输入是汇编文本而非原始机器字节，反汇编不属于该方法。
reference_records.scope_limitations_en: Evaluation covers about 4,000 ExeBench functions and a 112-program synthesis suite. Beam size 5 selects the first candidate passing finite I/O tests; generated functions are inserted into the original calling context. Passing these tests is not whole-program or all-input equivalence. Edit similarity is a readability proxy. Longer functions, external calls and incorrect type/operator predictions remain failure modes; the model has 1,024-position source and target windows. Historical baseline comparisons have different coverage and do not establish current rankings.
reference_records.scope_limitations_zh: 评测覆盖约 4,000 个 ExeBench 函数及含 112 个程序的合成基准。束宽为 5，并选择首个通过有限输入／输出测试的候选；生成函数被放回原始调用上下文。通过这些测试不代表完整程序或全部输入上的等价性。编辑相似度只是可读性的代理指标。较长函数、外部调用及错误的类型／运算符预测仍会导致失败；模型的输入和输出窗口均为 1,024 个位置。历史基线比较的覆盖范围不同，不能据此确立当前排名。
reference_records.why_fits_en: Adds type-inference-assisted neural decompilation with explicit execution-based evaluation, complementing symbol recovery and later LLM decompilation studies.
reference_records.why_fits_zh: 补充结合类型推断与执行结果评测的神经反编译方法，与符号恢复及后续大语言模型反编译研究互补。
reference_records.metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v3 dated 2024-02-15, the accepted CGO manuscript; publication metadata establishes the final venue and pages. Paper reference 65 links the Zenodo artifact. Its separate LICENSE restricts included code/data/models to paper reproducibility and calls it nonproduction research code; no permissive license is inferred. The 1.83 GB archive was not downloaded or inspected. Appendix prerequisites include Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.10.2, Transformers 4.22.2, PsycheC, Haskell Stack and an AArch64 GCC toolchain. BTC weights are not redistributed and ChatGPT outputs may change. These are documented historical requirements, not a verified installation; no code or experiments were run.
reference_records.metadata_notes_zh: 审阅 2024-02-15 发布的 arXiv v3，即 CGO 接收稿；出版元数据确认最终发表场所及页码。论文参考文献 65 链接至 Zenodo 产物，其独立 LICENSE 将所含代码／数据／模型限定用于论文复现，并说明这是不适合生产环境的研究代码，不能据此推定宽松许可。未下载或检查 1.83 GB 压缩包。附录列出的前提包括 Python 3.8、PyTorch 1.10.2、Transformers 4.22.2、PsycheC、Haskell Stack 及 AArch64 GCC 工具链。产物不再分发 BTC 权重，ChatGPT 输出也可能变化。这些是文档中的历史要求，并非已验证的安装环境；本次未运行代码或实验。

reference_records.name: Perfect Dark: matching Nintendo 64 decompilation
reference_records.description_en: Reconstructs Perfect Dark’s Nintendo 64 code with a documented matching-ROM build. The project combines reconstructed source with assets from a user-supplied original ROM, then checks version-specific artifact hashes. It is a reproducible-build research case, distinct from the separate native PC port; matching results remain project-reported here.
reference_records.description_zh: 重建 Perfect Dark 的 Nintendo 64 代码，并提供生成一致 ROM 的构建流程。项目将重建源码与使用者自备原 ROM 中的素材结合，再检查各版本产物的哈希。这是可复现构建研究案例，与独立的原生 PC 移植不同；此处的一致性结果仍为项目报告。
requirements: The reviewed GitHub repository mirrors Ryan Dwyer’s GitLab project. README describes a complete matching decompilation; six build targets cover NTSC beta, NTSC 1.0/final, PAL beta/final and Japanese final, with ntsc-final as default. This reconstructs an N64 ROM, not a Windows/Linux/macOS game executable or the separate Perfect Dark PC port.

Supply an independently authorized original ROM in non-byteswapped .z64 form, with header 0x80371240, named for the selected ROMID. make extract reads assets and comparison segments from that ROM; final builds also reuse extracted boot code. Existing extracted files are not overwritten, so modified inputs can invalidate matching results.

The documented host setup is Linux: GNU Make, host C/C++ tools, Python 3, MIPS binutils/GCC, armips, Capstone development files and the listed 32-bit libc headers. Initialize the pinned ido-static-recomp submodule. Matching mode reconstructs IDO 5.3 and 7.1 compiler tools from its IRIX inputs; optional GCC builds are nonmatching and limited to ntsc-1.0/ntsc-final.

After building, make test runs quiet MD5 verification against the selected version’s checksum manifest, including the final ROM and intermediate artifacts. The README also documents comparing base/built ROM hashes. These check output identity for the supplied version, not gameplay-path coverage or performance. The mutable status page reports all six versions complete/matching; this collection did not rerun those checks.

The repository declares MIT for source; original ROMs and extracted game assets retain separate rights. Compiler components have their own terms, including the submodule’s SGI notice for IDO 5.3; the project’s MIT declaration does not replace them. The reviewed sources establish no AI or REA attribution, and no runtime reproduction is claimed.
reference_records.name_zh: Perfect Dark：生成一致 ROM 的 Nintendo 64 反编译重建

reference_records.name: Super Mario 64: ROM reconstruction with explicit comparison gates
reference_records.description_en: Reconstructs Super Mario 64 source for Japanese, North American, European, Shindou and iQue releases. Its build files distinguish original-ROM hash comparison from nonmatching or modified configurations, while source naming and documentation remain ongoing.
reference_records.description_zh: 为日版、北美版、欧洲版、Shindou 版和 iQue 版 Super Mario 64 重建源码。构建文件区分原 ROM 哈希比较与非匹配或修改配置；源码命名和文档工作仍在推进。
requirements: Requires the user’s matching original ROM for asset extraction. The five target releases are separate; this repository’s reconstruction should not be confused with the separately maintained sm64ex, Ghostship or multiplayer ports.

The documented build uses GNU make, Python 3.6+, MIPS binutils, pkgconf and host development tools. Windows instructions use WSL/Linux; macOS instructions require an appropriate MIPS toolchain and newer GNU make.

The Makefile normally checks the output ROM’s SHA-1 against the selected reference. NON_MATCHING, a non-N64 target or nonstandard configurations disable comparison; a successful modified build is not a matching-result claim.

The pinned Jenkins configuration explicitly sets COMPARE=0 for iQue and enhancement builds. Its five-version build matrix therefore must not be described as five independently confirmed byte-identical results; no build or game was run for this catalog.

The repository carries CC0-1.0; original Nintendo content and any separate third-party rights are not supplied by that declaration. No REA or coding-agent involvement is established by the reviewed files.
reference_records.name_zh: Super Mario 64：带明确比较开关的 ROM 重建

reference_records.name: Pocket Tasks: reconstructing task state and persistence
reference_records.description_en: A teaching case with disclosed prior source access carries a REA-assisted investigation of a small command-line app into a separate Node implementation. It preserves observed task editing, persistence and selection behavior, then compares scoped outputs against fixed expectations and captured reference sessions.
reference_records.description_zh: 此教学案例明确披露作者先前接触过源码，将一次 REA 辅助的小型命令行应用调查推进为另行编写的 Node 实现。它保留所观察到的任务编辑、持久保存及选择行为，再将限定范围的输出与固定期望值及捕获的参考会话比较。
requirements: Pocket Tasks 1.0.0 is an authored local command-line app, not a commercial application or a native-binary benchmark. Its separate Node.js 20+ candidate implements nine commands and schema-1 JSON storage, including saved/draft separation, explicit save, cancel, restart and the original row-position selection quirk. It needs only the Node standard library and disposable local stores; there is no graphical interface or network backend.

The historical investigation combines REA JavaScript source analysis, ordinary source inspection and recorded process/file observations. The sanitized REA excerpt identifies the same target bytes but retains unknown semantic coverage and 230 semantic unknowns. It is not a canonical Evidence bundle or independent attestation, and parsing coverage is not behavioral equivalence. The later Node validator does not repeat that REA session.

The author had already seen the target source, reviewer scenarios, tests and prior answers before implementation. The candidate imports only Node filesystem/path modules; a published test definition copies its file alone before checking save behavior. Runtime independence from the reference does not establish independent discovery, a blind trial, clean-room provenance or an agent/model performance result.

The saved report records 16/16 checker process sessions across 12 scenarios and 10/10 replays of captured observations across seven scenarios. These overlap and must not be counted as 26 independent observations. The checker uses fixed, hand-authored expectations; responses and saved JSON are compared semantically, while malformed stores and foreign pending files use byte-preservation checks where required. The report retains humanReview=pending, reaTrial=unverified and independentEvaluation=false; these are author-reported results, not rerun by this collection.

The six recorded target/candidate/observation/validator/checker/packet-tool hashes and the oracle digest match the reviewed source. The report’s TASK.md packet hash instead matches an earlier instruction revision: a later edit changed review/authorization wording without changing the behavioral contract. Treat the packet record as historical evidence, not fresh validation of every file in the current package. The failure history also retains an initial restricted-Windows attempt with five passes and four failures, followed by nine passes with unchanged candidate code in a permitted local environment.

The contract bounds each invocation to 64 commands and 65,536 UTF-8 bytes, stores to 32 tasks and titles to 80 UTF-16 code units. Coverage is limited to named behaviors and tests; concurrent writers, crash durability, hostile filesystem races, UI behavior, hidden backends and production performance are outside the parity claim. MIT covers the authored example; upstream REA and other linked material remain separate. No target, candidate, checker, installer, model or upstream test was executed in this review.
reference_records.name_zh: Pocket Tasks：重建任务状态与持久保存行为

reference_records.name: Open Scrantic: reconstructing the Johnny Castaway screensaver engine
reference_records.description_en: Reconstructs the Johnny Castaway screensaver engine in Rust, with author-disclosed REA and Claude Code use. It reads original files to run recovered animation scripts and calendar-based story state on modern desktops; documented deviations and limited tests stop short of complete behavioral equivalence.
reference_records.description_zh: 以 Rust 重建 Johnny Castaway 屏幕保护程序引擎，作者明确披露使用 REA 与 Claude Code。它读取原始文件，在现代桌面上运行恢复的动画脚本及按日历推进的故事状态；文档保留实现差异与有限测试范围，未确立完整行为等价。
requirements: Reviewed at v0.3.0: this is a Windows 3.1 screensaver-engine reconstruction, not a game port. The author reports recovering formats and TTM/ADS script semantics from disassembly, with human-directed REA/Claude Code work and comparisons against the original. Those reports do not establish exhaustive parity or an independent agent-performance result.

Builds pin Rust 1.99.1; Cargo declares minimum Rust 1.99 and edition 2024. The project targets Windows, macOS and Linux using winit, softbuffer and rodio. Linux builds also require ALSA development headers and pkg-config.

Runtime requires separately obtained SCRANTIC.SCR, RESOURCE.MAP and RESOURCE.001 beside the executable. README sizes and SHA-256 values identify the expected original files; the loader instead checks known executable strings/layout, not whole-file hashes. Arbitrary original builds are unsupported. Options and story state use SCRANTIC.INI, saved on normal exit.

Deliberate differences include full-frame redraw, potentially one-pixel line/ellipse differences, bounded final-scene selection and a fixed two-second title display. Optional dedithering and softened audio default off. The original settings dialog and password feature are absent, as are unused animated-palette, 256-color and ADS-variable features.

The headless test runs 6,000 steps and requires three completed scenes, without original-frame comparison. Data-dependent tests silently return when OPEN_SCRANTIC_DATA is unset; other tests cover parsing and arithmetic. CI checks formatting, lint, three-platform builds and --version, not cargo test or original-data playback. Snapshot output supports inspection, not an automated original-output oracle.

MIT covers project source, not original executable content, art, scripts or sounds, which users must supply with appropriate authorization. The author describes independent, non-commercial interoperability without Sierra/Dynamix endorsement. This collection reviewed sources and test definitions; it did not reproduce the implementation or results.
reference_records.name_zh: Open Scrantic：重建 Johnny Castaway 屏幕保护程序引擎

reference_records.name: rauchg.com: rebuilding an RSC blog from captured Flight output
reference_records.description_en: Documents a website-rebuild-skill case that decodes browser-delivered React Server Component Flight streams, reconstructs a buildable Next project and compares its output with a captured site. The reported rauchg.com campaign uses route-tree comparison and module-reference mapping; the new server source is inferred from observable output.
reference_records.description_zh: 记录 website-rebuild-skill 的一个案例：解码浏览器收到的 React 服务端组件 Flight 流，重建可构建的 Next 项目，再与捕获站点的输出比较。作者报告的 rauchg.com 重建过程采用路由树比较与模块引用映射；新服务端源码由可观察输出推断。
requirements: The documented rauchg.com snapshot used Next 16.1.1, Turbopack and React 19 canary. The tooling requires Node.js 22+ and a local Chrome/Chromium for comparison; some stages invoke version-pinned external tools. Repeating the method needs an authorized target snapshot and a separately built reconstruction, not just the skill repository.

Flight decoding exposes delivered element trees, route state and client-module references. The reconstructed server-component source is explicitly an inference from that output; flight-to-mdx also needs site-specific shape/link adaptations. This is not extraction of undistributed server source or automatic recovery of an arbitrary Next.js application.

The author reports 18/18 routes passing a Flight semantic gate and a runtime sweep for this case. The gate compares normalized trees and enforces a global module-ID bijection. It normalizes build-hash namespaces and selected encoding differences; configured prop/class exclusions can omit registered fields or subtrees. A pass is not byte identity or full behavioral equivalence.

The gate does not check CSS, so layout, fonts and rendered pixels need separate comparisons. Public synthetic self-tests include changed-text rejection and rejection of a one-to-many module mapping. This review inspected those checks as source and did not run them or reproduce the reported website campaign.

The method explicitly leaves unobserved error responses, database/write paths, server caches, dynamic-image generator source and unlinked routes unresolved. Historical public-source comparisons and reported reconstruction percentages do not prove access to hidden backend logic; the author also notes possible model-training familiarity with a nominally blind target.

MIT applies to the skill and tooling, not to reconstructed websites, their scripts, fonts or other assets. The source documents separate authorization/publication decisions and private, noindex output defaults. No original-site assets or model payloads were downloaded, and no browser session or upstream script was run in this review.
reference_records.name_zh: rauchg.com：根据捕获的 Flight 输出重建 RSC 博客

reference_records.name: BaoCut Slides: adapting an interactive web editor
reference_records.description_en: Documents BaoCut’s interactive slide editor, whose author says the implementation draws on Claude Slides. It adds a local deck store, HTML/CSS compiler and annotation-to-agent bridge for browser and desktop hosts; the design reports a Web-flow check, without establishing original backend recovery or full behavioral parity.
reference_records.description_zh: 记录 BaoCut 交互式幻灯片编辑器，作者称其实现借鉴自 Claude Slides。它为浏览器与桌面宿主加入本地文稿存储、HTML/CSS 编译器及标注到智能体的桥接；设计说明报告了 Web 流程检查，但未确立原有后端恢复或完整行为一致性。
requirements: This entry covers the pinned Slides component, whose author says the implementation draws on Claude Slides, not the whole BaoCut product. It contains an editor runtime, a restricted HTML/CSS slide compiler and a new BaoCut host. Decks use a v4 deck.json index, per-slide HTML and local assets. The reviewed design/runtime notes do not identify the exact Claude Slides release or extraction record; they do not establish a clean-room process or recovery of Anthropic’s original hosted backend.

Building the editor requires Node.js >=22.12.0, npm workspace dependencies and the apps/slides-editor build; a BaoCut Runtime/host supplies file, annotation and download capabilities. The runtime declares React ^19.3.0 and PptxGenJS 3.12.0 with project patches. Full BaoCut source builds also require Rust/Cargo, CMake and platform C++ tools; Apple Silicon native inference needs full Xcode/Metal. Agent-driven deck creation requires a configured agent engine such as Codex CLI or Claude Code, with its own account and service terms.

The documented implementation is single-user and file-backed: it supports local saves with version/conflict checks, asset routes and external-change notifications. Conflict checks precede writes; individual-file writes do not establish whole-batch transactional rollback. Shared rooms/presence, share links, persistent comment threads and sending to Google Drive/Google Slides are explicitly out of scope. External updates may reload the editor and lose selection/scroll position. Export code exists, but the design still places PPTX/PDF downloads in P1; these documents do not establish complete export compatibility.

The design note reports end-to-end Web annotation validation and explicitly says Electron was not tested for that flow. Published tests exercise local file publication/conflicts, HTTP read/write boundaries and annotation forwarding; some host tests use fake fetch and agent-harness tests use a fake driver. HTML/CSS compiler and round-trip checks are skipped when the built compiler is unavailable. These are implementation tests, not an original-Claude differential oracle or proof of full visual/behavioral parity; this collection did not run them.

The root BaoCut Community License 1.0 is source-available: it permits stated personal/internal uses and content creation, while commercialization of the software/code or commercial hosting needs a separate license. Third-party components keep their own terms, including the documented PptxGenJS MIT and embedded mediabunny MPL-2.0 notices. Those dependency notices do not establish reuse rights in any reused Claude material or the bundled icon font; the runtime notes say that font needs replacement. This source review does not supply such rights or treat the whole component as permissively open source.

BaoCut documents agent-assisted creation and annotation workflows, but the reviewed case sources do not establish which model produced the adaptation or any REA involvement. Support for Claude Code/Codex as agent engines is not evidence of the reconstruction method. Use independently authorized slide content and respect external asset/font terms. This review inspected pinned source and test definitions without running the app, models or checks, or retrieving bundled fonts, media or application packages.
reference_records.name_zh: BaoCut Slides：交互式网页编辑器改编

reference_records.name: NJFE: a Soulear camera protocol bridge for desktop inspection
reference_records.description_en: Reuses otoscope's reverse-engineered i4season/Soulear protocol in an ESP32-C3 bridge and Python desktop viewer. The author credits Claude Code for implementation and reports streaming one Hopefox Find T to a Windows PC, with recording, orientation and LED controls.
reference_records.description_zh: 在 ESP32-C3 桥接器与 Python 电脑查看器中复用 otoscope 经逆向得到的 i4season／Soulear 协议。作者将实现归功于 Claude Code 辅助，报告把一台 Hopefox Find T 的视频传到 Windows 电脑，并提供录像、方向调整及 LED 控制。
requirements: The input is the camera's Wi-Fi i4season/Soulear UDP traffic. An ESP32-C3 SuperMini with the documented 0.42-inch, 72×40 SSD1306 OLED reassembles JPEG frames and forwards them with accelerometer metadata over custom USB CDC serial to the supplied Python viewer. This is not a UVC webcam output; the camera's own USB port is described as charge-only. No vendor-camera firmware or complete companion-app source is recovered.

The documented build uses PlatformIO espressif32 6.11.0, Arduino core 2.0.17 and U8g2 ^2.35.30. The desktop tools require Python with Tkinter plus pyserial >=3.5, opencv-python >=4.8, NumPy >=1.24 and Pillow >=12.3.0. The project reports Windows testing; it does not establish support for every desktop OS or compatible-looking ear camera.

The README and NOTICE credit rbeilvert/otoscope by rubec for the packet format, commands, frame assembly and accelerometer/rotation logic. That project documents reverse engineering Soulear's libWifiCamera.so. NJFE reports Claude Code assistance across research, implementation, tools and documentation, with the human supplying hardware, decisions and device testing. This does not establish Claude as the original protocol discoverer, or any REA involvement; NJFE does not pin the exact otoscope revision it borrowed.

The author reports one Hopefox Find T with HKV41B firmware, 480×480 JPEG at about 17 fps, plus photos, MJPG AVI recording, rotation and LED control. The public --test N viewer mode receives and decodes N live frames, saves the last image and prints frame rate; it needs the hardware. The reviewed tree has no separate offline conformance-fixture suite. These reports and source-level framing checks do not establish full protocol compatibility; this collection did not run the tools or reproduce the hardware result.

The camera network remains open and unauthenticated. SECURITY.md states that the bridge accepts UDP traffic without source authentication and can receive injected images or replies; serial access is trusted and recordings are stored unencrypted. A local USB bridge does not remove these camera-network limitations. The project describes an inspection tool, not a medical device for diagnosis or treatment.

NJFE declares GPL-3.0-or-later in its README, NOTICE and REUSE metadata, and identifies protocol code and roll calculation derived from GPL otoscope. Third-party build/runtime libraries retain their own licenses. Public source review does not grant rights to vendor software or images; no proprietary app, firmware binary, image capture, device or upstream runtime was used in this review.
reference_records.name_zh: NJFE：用于电脑检查的 Soulear 相机协议桥接

reference_records.name: TCLimate: reconstructing selected TCL Home cloud controls
reference_records.description_en: Implements selected TCL Home air-conditioner controls and electricity reporting in a native macOS menu-bar app. It adapts earlier community protocol work and documents an Android-module investigation to recover a separate statistics request. Reported validation checks cloud state, not independent physical operation or complete device equivalence.
reference_records.description_zh: 在原生 macOS 菜单栏应用中实现选定的 TCL Home 空调控制与用电量报告。项目改编既有社区协议实现，并记录通过调查 Android 模块恢复另一条统计请求的过程。报告的验证检查云端状态，不等于独立核实设备实际运行或完整设备等价性。
requirements: Reviewed v0.1.6 beta requires macOS 14+, internet access and a TCL account with already-paired ACs. Building needs Swift 6.0+, Xcode Command Line Tools and a persistent signing certificate for the packaged app. Pairing still uses TCL Home; local LAN control and direct Google sign-in are absent.

The protocol implementation credits nemesa’s MIT-licensed Home Assistant integration. The electricity API was reportedly identified through Android Flutter-module inspection and a successful request capture; original packages, captures and detailed investigation logs are not included in the repository. The inspected repository does not establish the collection report’s REA/mitmproxy attribution.

Source guards commands using reported model/state fields, restricts target temperature to whole degrees from 16–30°C, and checks reported state after sending. Optimistic UI changes are not themselves confirmation; unsuccessful confirmation is marked. Extra controls depend on available fields and modes, rather than assuming every AC supports them.

Author validation covers a Pakistan account and two Split AC-1 units: authentication, discovery, reported state, power, temperature and daily electricity. Modes, fan, airflow and other optional controls lack physical validation; other regions/models remain unverified. Cloud confirmation does not independently establish airflow or compressor operation.

Energy parsing preserves genuine zeros, excludes invalid readings and leaves missing days as gaps; a seven-day total requires all seven readings. No persistent energy history or cost estimate is implemented. Offline tests are reported but absent from the reviewed tree/package targets. This source review did not run tests or devices.

MIT covers project code, with attribution retained for the earlier integration. Official services and third-party material retain separate terms. This is an unofficial cloud-dependent client, not recovered TCL source or firmware; APIs may change independently of the app.
reference_records.name_zh: TCLimate：重建选定的 TCL Home 云端控制

subtitle.en: Methods, evidence and limits across six domains of software reconstruction.
subtitle.zh: 软件重建六个领域中的方法、证据与边界。

description.en: A bilingual survey of reverse engineering across websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols, grounded in 53 papers and eight project cases.
description.zh: 依据 53 篇论文与八个项目案例，讨论网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议逆向工程的方法、评测证据与边界的双语专题综述，并附参考文献与引用格式。

abstract.en: Reverse engineering reconstructs different objects from different evidence: a visual layout from an image, a rule model from interaction, source hypotheses from binary code, or an execution environment around retained firmware. This editorial survey brings together a frozen corpus of 53 papers and eight documented project cases to examine what those reconstructions establish. We organize the literature across websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols, comparing observation access, reconstructed outputs and acceptance checks. The central argument is that an outcome becomes interpretable only when all three are specified. Visual similarity, a matching build, finite test agreement and successful service startup constrain different properties and cannot be combined into a single recovery score. The selected cases show how original assets, prior source exposure, inherited implementations and cloud dependencies further shape a result. Across domains, the strongest opportunities for clearer evaluation are explicit accounting of supplied information, checks beyond construction-time examples, and separate reporting of structural, visual and behavioral evidence. This synthesis provides a framework for comparing claims and identifying untested boundaries, rather than a ranking of systems. [[paper-slade]] [[paper-programdistill]] [[paper-halucinator]]
abstract.zh: 逆向工程从不同证据重建不同对象：从图像恢复视觉布局，从交互推断规则模型，从二进制代码生成源码假设，或围绕保留的固件构建执行环境。本专题综述综合一个固定的 53 篇论文语料及八个有文档支持的项目案例，考察这些重建究竟能够确立什么。文献按网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议六个领域组织，比较观察权限、重建输出及验收判据。核心论点是：只有同时明确这三者，结果才可得到恰当解释。视觉相似、构建匹配、有限测试一致及服务成功启动，分别约束不同属性，不能合并为单一恢复分数。所选案例进一步说明，原始素材、先前源码接触、既有实现和云服务依赖如何塑造结果。跨领域来看，更清晰的评测有赖于明确记录所提供的信息、使用构建样例之外的检查，并分别报告结构、视觉和行为证据。本综述提供比较主张和识别未测试边界的框架，而非系统排名。[[paper-slade]] [[paper-programdistill]] [[paper-halucinator]]

disclosure.en: AI-assisted editorial synthesis. No new experiments; not peer reviewed.
disclosure.zh: 借助 AI 编写的专题综述；无新增实验，未经同行评审。

reference_note.en: Corpus membership and reference records are frozen at the snapshot shown above. All 53 papers are retained in the bibliography, including entries not cited in the narrative; the eight selected cases are also included. Linked collection entries may be updated separately. Changes to this survey’s paper corpus, reference metadata or bibliographic dates require a new version and date.
reference_note.zh: 语料成员及参考记录固定于上述快照。参考文献保留全部 53 篇论文，包括正文未引用的条目，并包含所选八个案例。链接的合集条目可能另行更新。若调整本综述的论文语料、参考元数据或引文日期，需要更新综述版本和日期。

figure_caption.en: Read these four stages as a reporting framework, not a universal reconstruction algorithm. The available evidence constrains the target that can be inferred; the acceptance oracle determines which properties of that target were actually checked.
figure_caption.zh: 这四个阶段是报告框架，不是通用重建算法。可用证据约束能够推断的目标，而验收判据决定目标的哪些属性实际接受了检查。

findings.en: A layout, an executable model, recovered source hypotheses and a rehosted environment are different reconstruction outputs. [[paper-redraw]] [[paper-worldcoder]] [[paper-halucinator]]
findings.zh: 布局、可执行模型、恢复的源码假设及重托管环境，是不同的重建输出。[[paper-redraw]] [[paper-worldcoder]] [[paper-halucinator]]

findings.en: Supplied context and human corrections belong in the input specification, not outside the comparison. [[paper-slade]] [[paper-declarui]]
findings.zh: 提供的上下文与人工修正应计入输入说明，不能置于比较之外。[[paper-slade]] [[paper-declarui]]

findings.en: Visual and behavioral checks constrain different properties; finite workflow agreement leaves further behavior untested. [[paper-design2code]] [[paper-programdistill]]
findings.zh: 视觉检查与行为检查约束不同属性；有限工作流上的一致仍留下未测试行为。[[paper-design2code]] [[paper-programdistill]]

findings.en: Reused implementations, original assets and artifact terms affect both attribution and reproducibility. [[njfe-ear-camera-bridge-case]] [[perfect-dark-matching-decomp-case]] [[paper-slade]]
findings.zh: 复用的实现、原始素材及产物条款，同时影响归因与可复现性。[[njfe-ear-camera-bridge-case]] [[perfect-dark-matching-decomp-case]] [[paper-slade]]

text.en: Images, observations, traces, binaries or source; record access and supplied context.
text.zh: 图像、观察、轨迹、二进制或源码；记录访问权限及额外上下文。

text.en: Specify the layout, code, behavior model or execution environment to produce.
text.zh: 明确要生成的布局、代码、行为模型或执行环境。

text.en: Identify the reference, comparison rule, tested inputs and permitted approximations.
text.zh: 明确参考对象、比较规则、测试输入及允许的近似。

text.en: Report what matched, what was reused, and which properties remain untested.
text.zh: 报告哪些内容匹配、哪些内容被复用，以及哪些属性仍未测试。

paragraphs.en: The literature discussion uses the 53-paper corpus frozen for this version. This synthesis examines what publicly documented reconstruction cases can establish about agent-assisted reverse engineering. The pinned catalog contains 189 resources, including 56 case studies. Eight cases are selected for contrasts in inputs, outputs and checks, not to estimate success rates or rank tools. Conventional matching-decompilation projects provide reference points for evaluating newer agent-assisted workflows; inclusion does not imply AI or REA involvement.
paragraphs.zh: 文献讨论采用本版本固定的 53 篇论文语料。本节综合讨论公开重建案例能够为智能体辅助逆向工程提供何种证据。固定版本的目录包含 189 项资源，其中 56 项为案例。这里选取八例，比较输入、输出与检查方式，不据此估计成功率或对工具排名。传统的一致性反编译项目为评估较新的智能体辅助流程提供参照；被选入不代表使用了 AI 或 REA。

paragraphs.en: Discovery ledgers are used to track leads and review coverage, not as a sample of reconstruction performance. They include unresolved reports, discussions and tools, so listing counts are not counts of independently verified projects. The eight selected cases provide purposive contrasts within this catalog snapshot; they do not constitute an exhaustive or systematic search.
paragraphs.zh: 发现线索记录用于跟踪线索及审阅覆盖，不作为重建性能的样本。其中包含待核查报告、讨论和工具，因此列入记录的数量不等于独立验证的项目数量。所选八例用于在本次目录快照中进行有目的的对比，并不构成穷尽式或系统检索。

paragraphs.en: The analysis uses the catalog’s recorded source reviews: pinned documentation, implementation and test definitions, stated prerequisites, and explicit limitations. Source-reviewed means that supporting material was inspected; it does not mean that the original, reconstruction or tests were executed for this survey. Author-reported results remain attributed. A build recipe, a test definition and a saved passing result are different evidence objects.
paragraphs.zh: 分析依据目录已有的来源审阅记录，包括固定修订的文档、实现与测试定义、使用前提及明确的限制。“来源已审阅”表示检查过支持材料，并不表示为本综述运行了原程序、重建实现或测试。作者报告的结果仍保留归因。构建步骤、测试定义和保存的通过结果，是不同的证据对象。

paragraphs.en: Here, an acceptance oracle means a rule, reference, or test used to judge a reconstructed output. For each case, we distinguish the available input, reconstructed output, acceptance check and untested remainder. This prevents a successful intermediate step from silently becoming a claim about an entire product. Source pins and version restrictions matter because later changes can alter the target, validator or dependencies without changing a project’s name.
paragraphs.zh: 下文所称验收判据（oracle），指用于判断重建输出的规则、参照或测试。每个案例均区分可用输入、重建输出、验收检查及未测试部分，避免将中间步骤的成功悄然扩大为对整个产品的结论。来源修订与版本限制同样重要：项目名称不变时，后续修改仍可能改变目标、验证器或依赖。

paragraphs.en: A useful evidence record separates checks that are defined, eligible, executed and passed. A missing fixture, disabled comparison or absent original file is a coverage gap, not a successful result. Likewise, compilation and startup checks establish different properties from a differential test. Reporting skipped checks and configuration switches alongside successes would make heterogeneous case reports easier to compare without pretending that their denominators are interchangeable.
paragraphs.zh: 有用的证据记录应区分已定义、满足执行条件、实际执行及通过的检查。缺失样本、关闭比较或缺少原始文件，都属于覆盖缺口，而不是成功结果。同样，编译与启动检查确立的性质不同于差分测试。在报告成功的同时列出跳过项与配置开关，有助于比较异质案例，也避免假定它们的统计分母可以互换。

paragraphs.en: Reverse engineering begins with an information gap, but the artifact used to bridge that gap varies considerably. A screenshot can support a layout, execution traces can constrain behavior, and implementation access can expose types or dependencies. The reconstructed object may therefore be a page, a transition model, annotated pseudocode, or an environment that runs existing firmware. These objects answer different questions. The same term can therefore cover inversion of visual design, inference of hidden rules, or construction of an executable surrogate around retained code. Input access and the required output must be specified together. [[paper-design2code]] [[paper-worldcoder]] [[paper-dire]] [[paper-halucinator]]
paragraphs.zh: 逆向工程始于信息缺口，但用于弥合缺口的产物差异很大。截图可以支持布局推断，执行轨迹可以约束行为，访问实现则可能揭示类型或依赖。因此，重建对象可能是页面、状态转移模型、带注释的伪代码，也可能是能够运行现有固件的环境。这些产物回答的是不同问题。因此，同一个术语可能涵盖视觉设计的逆向转换、隐藏规则推断，或围绕保留代码构建可执行的替代环境。可访问的输入与要求的输出必须一并明确。[[paper-design2code]] [[paper-worldcoder]] [[paper-dire]] [[paper-halucinator]]

paragraphs.en: A recurring difficulty is underdetermination: different implementations can explain the same observations. Visual resemblance does not identify business logic; passing sampled executions does not recover original source; and a useful emulator may intentionally simplify hardware. Three distinctions organize the discussion: observed evidence versus supplied specifications, reconstruction versus reuse of existing components, and a measured outcome versus the broader claim it is intended to support. The relevant question is which properties the evidence constrains, and which remain untested. [[paper-ui2app]] [[paper-slade]] [[paper-firmae]]
paragraphs.zh: 一个反复出现的困难是欠确定性：不同实现可能解释相同观察。视觉相似无法确定业务逻辑，通过抽样执行不能恢复原始源码，有用的模拟环境也可能有意简化硬件。以下讨论区分三组概念：观察所得证据与额外提供的规范、重建与复用现有组件、测得的结果与该结果试图支持的更广泛主张。关键在于证据约束了哪些属性，以及哪些属性仍未检验。[[paper-ui2app]] [[paper-slade]] [[paper-firmae]]

title.en: Websites: from appearance to observable workflows
title.zh: 网站：从外观到可观察工作流

paragraphs.en: Screenshot-to-code research treats rendered appearance as the main reference. Design2Code combines visual-element and layout measures with human assessment, while Web2Code separates screenshot understanding from HTML generation. DCGen decomposes screenshots into regions; ScreenCoder separates visual grounding, layout planning and code generation. However, a generated button can look correct without implementing any action. Placeholder media and self-contained page snapshots also alter the reconstruction problem, so visual scores should be read with the supplied assets and reference construction in view. [[paper-design2code]] [[paper-web2code]] [[paper-dcgen]] [[paper-screencoder]]
paragraphs.zh: 截图到代码研究主要以渲染外观为参考。Design2Code 将视觉元素、布局指标与人工评估结合；Web2Code 则区分截图理解和 HTML 生成。DCGen 将截图分解为多个区域；ScreenCoder 则分离视觉定位、布局规划与代码生成。不过，生成的按钮外观正确，并不意味着它实现了任何动作。占位素材和自包含页面快照也会改变任务本身，因此应结合所提供的素材及参考数据构建方式理解视觉分数。[[paper-design2code]] [[paper-web2code]] [[paper-dcgen]] [[paper-screencoder]]

paragraphs.en: Interactive benchmarks supply or infer additional evidence. Interaction2Code provides before-and-after states for individual transitions; IWR-Bench uses interaction videos and annotated replay sequences. These test observed changes beyond a static screenshot, but IWR-Bench explicitly allows implied backend behavior to be mocked with static JavaScript data. UI2App instead asks models to infer plausible interactions from screenshots and accepts multiple valid implementations under a rubric. These are distinct tasks: reproducing demonstrated transitions and inventing behavior consistent with a design. Neither alone identifies the original server implementation, and cross-route state should not be equated with persistence across sessions. [[paper-interaction2code]] [[paper-iwr-bench]] [[paper-ui2app]]
paragraphs.zh: 交互基准提供或推断额外证据。Interaction2Code 为单次转移提供前后状态；IWR-Bench 使用交互视频和带标注的回放序列。这些任务检验了静态截图之外的变化，但 IWR-Bench 明确允许用静态 JavaScript 数据模拟隐含的后端行为。UI2App 则要求模型从截图推断合理交互，并依据评分规则接受多种有效实现。复现已展示的转移，与构造符合设计的行为，是两类不同任务。单独完成其中任何一类，都无法确定原始服务端实现；跨路由状态也不应等同于跨会话持久化。[[paper-interaction2code]] [[paper-iwr-bench]] [[paper-ui2app]]

paragraphs.en: ProgramDistill shifts emphasis toward behavior: evaluated agents inspect live references through structured browser observations, and submitted code is checked through dependent workflows in a fresh verification environment. Vision2Web also tests workflows, but its full-stack tier supplies written requirements alongside visual prototypes. Dashboard2Code adds active exploration within a particular dashboard framework. Access to text, selectors, DOM information or explicit requirements changes what must be inferred. Comparisons must therefore separate observation access from reconstruction skill. Workflow replay can expose a failed saved edit or an incorrect sequence of actions, while still leaving untested database invariants and visual fidelity outside its guarantees. [[paper-programdistill]] [[paper-vision2web]] [[paper-dashboard2code]]
paragraphs.zh: ProgramDistill 将重点转向行为：被评测智能体通过结构化浏览器观察检查运行中的参考应用，提交代码则在新的验证环境中接受有依赖关系的工作流检查。Vision2Web 也测试工作流，但其全栈任务同时提供视觉原型和文字需求。Dashboard2Code 则在特定仪表盘框架中加入主动探索。文本、选择器、DOM 信息或明确需求的可用性，会改变需要推断的内容。因此，比较时必须区分观察权限与重建能力。工作流回放可以发现编辑未保存或动作序列错误，却仍无法保证未测试的数据库不变量或视觉保真度。[[paper-programdistill]] [[paper-vision2web]] [[paper-dashboard2code]]

title.en: Games: interfaces, rules and executable world models
title.zh: 游戏：界面、规则与可执行世界模型

paragraphs.en: Game reconstruction spans several layers that should remain separate. SPRITE converts interface mockups into editable Unity UI assets, addressing hierarchy, visual grounding and basic interaction. GameReplica asks agents to explore rule-driven web games and create runnable HTML replicas. The former reconstructs a presentation layer; the latter attempts to infer rules through interaction. GameReplica uses model judges for its rule, implementation and visual scores. Neither task establishes reconstruction of a commercial native game, its original assets or its complete engine. A plausible interface, a playable implementation and a faithful ruleset are independent achievements, even when a benchmark reports them together. [[paper-sprite-game-ui]] [[paper-gamereplica]]
paragraphs.zh: 游戏重建包含应分别讨论的多个层次。SPRITE 将界面设计稿转换为可编辑的 Unity UI 素材，关注层级、视觉定位和基础交互。GameReplica 则要求智能体探索规则驱动的网页游戏，并生成可运行的 HTML 复刻。前者重建表现层，后者尝试通过交互推断规则。GameReplica 使用模型对规则、实现及视觉表现评分。两类任务都不能据此证明重建了商业原生游戏、原始素材或完整引擎。合理的界面、可玩的实现与忠实的规则集，是相互独立的成果，即使某个基准同时报告它们。[[paper-sprite-game-ui]] [[paper-gamereplica]]

paragraphs.en: Executable world models offer another objective: recover enough transition and reward behavior to support planning. WorldCoder refines Python models against experiences and planning constraints, assuming deterministic symbolic environments. Code World Models combines descriptions and recorded trajectories with program synthesis guided by search. Tycho builds and checks programmatic models from unfamiliar game interactions, but can repair, abstain from or bypass a model during play. These designs make reconstruction instrumental to task solving. Consequently, successful play cannot alone show that the learned simulator is correct: an agent may exploit a locally useful approximation or succeed through another part of its control loop. [[paper-worldcoder]] [[paper-code-world-models]] [[paper-tycho]]
paragraphs.zh: 可执行世界模型提出另一种目标：恢复足以支持规划的状态转移和奖励行为。WorldCoder 在确定性的符号环境假设下，依据经验及规划约束修订 Python 模型。Code World Models 将文字描述、已记录轨迹与搜索引导的程序合成结合。Tycho 根据陌生游戏中的交互构建并检查程序化模型，但在游戏过程中可以修复模型、对部分预测保留意见，或绕过模型。这些设计把重建作为完成任务的手段。因此，仅凭游戏通关无法证明所学模拟器正确：智能体可能利用局部有效的近似，也可能依靠控制循环的其他部分成功。[[paper-worldcoder]] [[paper-code-world-models]] [[paper-tycho]]

paragraphs.en: RevengeBench narrows the unknown object further to executable decision policies, evaluated through held-out action agreement and competitive value. This distinguishes recovering an opponent's policy from rebuilding the environment in which it acts. Across these studies, exploration policy, access to symbolic state or textual rules, and the distribution of tested states determine the difficulty. A promising research direction is to evaluate models on interventions beyond their construction traces, while reporting model fidelity separately from task reward. Deterministic toy worlds and fixed policies provide useful controlled experiments, but do not establish performance on stochastic, partially observed or adaptive game systems. [[paper-revengebench]] [[paper-worldcoder]] [[paper-code-world-models]]
paragraphs.zh: RevengeBench 将未知对象进一步限定为可执行决策策略，通过留出状态上的动作一致性和对抗价值进行评估。这区分了恢复对手策略与重建策略所处环境。在这些研究中，探索策略、符号状态或文字规则的可用性，以及测试状态的分布，共同决定任务难度。一个值得研究的方向，是在构建轨迹之外施加干预来评估模型，同时分别报告模型保真度与任务奖励。确定性简化环境和固定策略能够提供受控实验，但不能据此确立在随机、部分可观察或自适应游戏系统中的表现。[[paper-revengebench]] [[paper-worldcoder]] [[paper-code-world-models]]

title.en: Apps: recovering structure without assuming application logic
title.zh: 应用：恢复界面结构，而不预设业务逻辑已恢复

paragraphs.en: Mobile GUI research illustrates how the choice of representation shapes the result. REMAUI uses vision, OCR and layout heuristics to generate Android interfaces. UI2code learns a component hierarchy and skeleton, while ReDraw combines component recognition with a plausible hierarchy drawn from interface examples. Pix2code instead predicts a domain-specific language compiled into platform UI code. These approaches make different trade-offs between visual detail, hierarchy and platform specificity. Their outputs can accelerate implementation, but component or token accuracy is not a measure of recovered application logic. Multiple hierarchies may render similar screens while behaving differently under resizing or interaction. [[paper-remaui]] [[paper-ui2code]] [[paper-redraw]] [[paper-pix2code]]
paragraphs.zh: 移动 GUI 研究说明，表示方式的选择会塑造重建结果。REMAUI 使用视觉、OCR 和布局启发式方法生成 Android 界面；UI2code 学习组件层级与骨架；ReDraw 则将组件识别与从界面样例中获得的合理层级结合。Pix2code 采用另一条路线：预测领域专用语言，再编译为平台 UI 代码。这些方法在视觉细节、层级和平台专属性之间作出不同取舍。输出可以加快实现，但组件或词元准确率并不是应用逻辑恢复程度的度量。多种层级可能渲染出相似屏幕，却在调整尺寸或交互时表现不同。[[paper-remaui]] [[paper-ui2code]] [[paper-redraw]] [[paper-pix2code]]

paragraphs.en: Moving beyond a single screen introduces navigation as a separate inference problem. DeclarUI combines component extraction and generated declarative code with page-transition graphs that people review and correct. This makes the human contribution part of the method, rather than evidence that transitions were recovered autonomously. UIOrchestra organizes layout description, generation and visual comparison into cooperating agents, but its studied output is static React/CSS. Its mobile-derived reference pairs are human-refined reconstructions, not original app source. The distinction matters when comparing against earlier native Android outputs or claiming that a generated page constitutes an executable native application. [[paper-declarui]] [[paper-uiorchestra]]
paragraphs.zh: 从单屏扩展到多屏，会引入独立的导航推断问题。DeclarUI 将组件提取和声明式代码生成，与经人工检查修正的页面转移图结合。人工贡献因此是方法的一部分，不能被视为自主恢复转移关系的证据。UIOrchestra 把布局描述、生成及视觉比较组织为协作智能体，但其研究输出是静态 React/CSS。来自移动界面的参考数据对是经人工修订的重建结果，并非原始应用源码。在与早期原生 Android 输出比较，或声称生成页面构成可执行原生应用时，这一区分尤其重要。[[paper-declarui]] [[paper-uiorchestra]]

paragraphs.en: The open problem is how to connect interface recovery to independently specified behavior without silently filling gaps. A screenshot cannot determine authentication rules, synchronization, permissions or off-screen state. Navigation graphs constrain some transitions, yet leave business semantics unresolved. Future comparisons should identify which elements came from images, which were supplied by people, and which were invented by the generator; they should also separate compilation, visual matching and runtime behavior. Artifact availability is an additional dimension: a described method or promised release can support a literature discussion without establishing that its complete implementation has been inspected or reproduced. [[paper-declarui]] [[paper-uiorchestra]] [[paper-redraw]]
paragraphs.zh: 尚待解决的问题，是如何把界面恢复与独立规定的行为连接起来，而不悄然补造缺失信息。截图无法确定身份认证规则、同步机制、权限或屏幕之外的状态。导航图约束了部分转移，却仍留下业务语义问题。未来比较应明确哪些元素来自图像，哪些由人提供，哪些由生成器构造，并分别报告编译、视觉匹配和运行行为。产物可用性是另一维度：方法描述或发布承诺可以支撑文献讨论，却不能证明其完整实现已经接受检查或复现。[[paper-declarui]] [[paper-uiorchestra]] [[paper-redraw]]

title.en: Binaries: symbols, source hypotheses and behavior
title.zh: 二进制：符号、源码假设与行为

paragraphs.en: Binary research separates assistance to an analyst from generation of replacement source. DIRE predicts variable names from lexical and structural decompiler information; DIRTY adds learned types and layout cues. ReSym introduces cross-function reasoning to reduce conflicts in symbol and data-structure predictions. These methods recover useful abstractions, but names and types remain hypotheses conditioned on a decompiler and training distribution. Agreement between predictions is weaker than evidence that they match unavailable source. The distinction is consequential: improved readability can help analysis even when it neither changes executable behavior nor yields a compilable replacement. [[paper-dire]] [[paper-dirty]] [[paper-resym]]
paragraphs.zh: 二进制研究区分了辅助分析人员与生成替代源码两类目标。DIRE 根据反编译结果的词法和结构信息预测变量名；DIRTY 加入学习得到的类型及布局线索；ReSym 则通过跨函数推理减少符号与数据结构预测之间的冲突。这些方法恢复了有用的抽象，但名称和类型仍是受底层反编译器及训练分布制约的假设。预测相互一致，弱于它们与不可见源码一致的证据。这一区分具有实际意义：即使没有改变可执行行为，也没有生成可编译的替代实现，提高可读性仍可帮助分析。[[paper-dire]] [[paper-dirty]] [[paper-resym]]

paragraphs.en: Assembly-to-C systems make a stronger output commitment. LLM4Decompile studies both generation from assembly and refinement of Ghidra pseudocode, while SLaDe combines neural translation with type completion. Their execution-based evaluations improve on text similarity alone, but the experimental context is essential. SLaDe selects a candidate using finite I/O tests and evaluates functions within their original calling context. Function boundaries, external declarations, compiler settings and candidate selection therefore contribute to the measured result. A test-passing function should not be interpreted as a recovered whole program, and recompilation alone is insufficient evidence of semantic preservation. [[paper-llm4decompile]] [[paper-slade]]
paragraphs.zh: 汇编到 C 系统对输出作出了更强的承诺。LLM4Decompile 同时研究从汇编生成代码和修订 Ghidra 伪代码；SLaDe 则将神经翻译与类型补全结合。基于执行的评测比仅比较文本更有约束力，但实验上下文至关重要。SLaDe 使用有限输入／输出测试选择候选，并在原始调用上下文中评估函数。因此，函数边界、外部声明、编译器设置和候选选择过程都参与形成了测量结果。通过测试的函数不应被理解为已恢复的完整程序，仅能重新编译也不足以证明语义得到保留。[[paper-llm4decompile]] [[paper-slade]]

paragraphs.en: DeGPT illustrates the different risks of rewriting existing decompiler output: simplification and naming may aid comprehension, while heuristic semantic checks can miss harmful changes. DecompileBench broadens evaluation to functions from real programs and combines behavioral checks with understandability assessment, but finite fuzzing coverage and model-assisted judgments remain bounded oracles. The useful comparison is thus multidimensional: symbol plausibility, structural readability, compilation, tested behavior and preserved dependencies. Research that reports these separately is easier to interpret than a single decompilation score. Testing beyond the examples used to select or repair an output is especially important for detecting plausible-looking mistakes. [[paper-degpt]] [[paper-decompilebench]] [[paper-slade]]
paragraphs.zh: DeGPT 展示了改写现有反编译输出的另一类风险：简化和命名可以帮助理解，启发式语义检查却可能漏掉有害修改。DecompileBench 把评测扩展到真实程序中的函数，并结合行为检查与可理解性评估，但有限的模糊测试覆盖和模型辅助判断仍是有边界的判定依据。因此，有用的比较应包含多个维度：符号合理性、结构可读性、编译情况、已测试行为及依赖保留情况。分别报告这些维度，比给出单一反编译分数更易解释。尤其应使用候选选择或修复过程之外的样例进行测试，以发现看似合理的错误。[[paper-degpt]] [[paper-decompilebench]] [[paper-slade]]

title.en: Firmware: rebuilding an environment around retained binaries
title.zh: 固件：围绕保留的二进制重建执行环境

paragraphs.en: Firmware rehosting usually retains the target binary and reconstructs the environment it expects. HALucinator identifies hardware-abstraction interfaces and substitutes authored handlers, allowing model fidelity to vary with the analysis objective. Fuzzware operates closer to memory-mapped I/O, using scoped symbolic analysis to identify inputs relevant to firmware logic. Both reduce the burden of complete peripheral emulation through abstraction. That reduction is productive for testing, but it also defines a boundary: omitted hardware behavior, timing or direct memory access (DMA) can change reachable executions, and a crash in the analysis environment may not be physically realizable. [[paper-halucinator]] [[paper-fuzzware]]
paragraphs.zh: 固件重托管通常保留目标二进制，并重建它所期待的环境。HALucinator 识别硬件抽象接口，以人工编写的处理函数替换它们，允许模型保真度随分析目标调整。Fuzzware 更接近内存映射 I/O，通过局部符号分析识别与固件逻辑有关的输入。两者都借助抽象，减轻完整模拟外设的负担。这种简化有利于测试，同时也界定了方法边界：省略硬件行为、时序或直接内存访问（DMA）可能改变可达执行，而分析环境中的崩溃未必能在真实设备上发生。[[paper-halucinator]] [[paper-fuzzware]]

paragraphs.en: Linux firmware brings another set of dependencies, including files, initialization processes, networking and kernel services. FirmAE uses empirical interventions to overcome execution failures and bring up selected web services. FIRMWELL reconstructs service dependencies through initialization and analysis, while Penguin makes target-specific transformations explicit and editable. These are related attempts to make retained software analyzable, but their success conditions differ. Binding a web port, returning a nonempty response and passing configured service checks establish different observations, not interchangeable definitions of a functioning device. The amount of execution behavior deliberately changed must remain part of the interpretation. [[paper-firmae]] [[paper-firmwell]] [[paper-penguin]]
paragraphs.zh: Linux 固件包含另一组依赖，包括文件、初始化进程、网络和内核服务。FirmAE 使用经验性干预克服执行故障，使选定的 Web 服务运行起来；FIRMWELL 通过初始化与分析恢复服务依赖；Penguin 则将针对目标的转换明确表示为可编辑配置。这些方法都试图让保留的软件能够接受分析，但成功标准不同。绑定 Web 端口、返回非空响应、通过配置的服务检查，是不同的观察，不能互换为“设备正常运行”的定义。执行行为被有意改变了多少，也必须纳入解释。[[paper-firmae]] [[paper-firmwell]] [[paper-penguin]]

paragraphs.en: The central research tension is between reachability and fidelity. A permissive model can expose more code while also admitting impossible inputs; a detailed model may demand substantial manual knowledge and still miss a peripheral condition. Useful evaluations should connect accepted service behavior and discovered faults to documented assumptions, then distinguish emulator-only observations from checks on physical devices. This also makes negative results informative: unsupported architectures, incomplete unpacking, missing initialization or failed peripheral models are different failure categories. None of these rehosting achievements alone implies original-source recovery or reconstruction of every device function. [[paper-fuzzware]] [[paper-halucinator]] [[paper-firmwell]]
paragraphs.zh: 核心研究张力在于可达性与保真度。宽松模型可能暴露更多代码，同时允许现实中不可能出现的输入；详细模型可能需要大量人工知识，却仍遗漏某种外设条件。有用的评测应把服务验收和发现的故障与明确记录的假设联系起来，并区分仅在模拟器中观察到的结果与真实设备检查。这也使负面结果具有信息价值：不支持的架构、不完整的解包、缺失的初始化和失败的外设模型，属于不同故障类别。任何一类重托管成果，都不能单独证明恢复了原始源码或重建了设备的全部功能。[[paper-fuzzware]] [[paper-halucinator]] [[paper-firmwell]]

title.en: Protocols: syntax, semantics and state are different targets
title.zh: 协议：语法、语义与状态是不同目标

paragraphs.en: Passive protocol inference learns from messages without observing the implementation. NEMESYS estimates boundaries within individual messages; NetPlier uses relationships across traces to infer type-related fields and clusters; BinaryInferno combines specialized detectors into partial format descriptions. Their assumptions about plaintext, alignment, sample diversity and prior grouping differ. Even the unit of correctness changes: a boundary match, an exactly segmented field and a correctly clustered message answer different questions. Analyst priors and ground-truth preprocessing must be counted as inputs. Partial format recovery can be valuable without identifying all semantics or discovering messages absent from the sample. [[paper-nemesys]] [[paper-netplier]] [[paper-binaryinferno]]
paragraphs.zh: 被动协议推断从报文中学习，而不观察实现。NEMESYS 估计单条报文内部的边界；NetPlier 利用多条轨迹之间的关系推断与类型有关的字段及聚类；BinaryInferno 将专门的检测器组合为部分格式描述。它们对明文、对齐、样本多样性和预先分组的假设各不相同。正确性的单位也会改变：边界匹配、完整分割的字段、正确聚类的报文，回答的是不同问题。分析人员提供的先验和使用真实标签进行的预处理，都应计入输入。即使无法识别全部语义或发现样本中不存在的报文，部分格式恢复仍可能有用。[[paper-nemesys]] [[paper-netplier]] [[paper-binaryinferno]]

paragraphs.en: Implementation access supplies stronger constraints at a different cost. BinPRE observes instrumented server execution to infer fields and selected semantic categories; ICEPRE follows concrete parser paths and symbolically replays them for syntax inference. NetLifter instead requires annotated C/LLVM input and statically derives grammars with cross-field constraints. These methods cannot be ranked fairly as if they received the same evidence. They also inherit different blind spots: unexercised paths, manual function identification, implementation-ignored fields, and approximation of loops or checksums. Improved fuzzing is evidence of a useful downstream application, not proof that a complete interoperable endpoint has been reconstructed. [[paper-binpre]] [[paper-icepre]] [[paper-netlifter]]
paragraphs.zh: 访问实现能够提供更强的约束，同时带来不同成本。BinPRE 观察经插桩服务器的执行，推断字段及选定语义类别；ICEPRE 沿具体解析路径运行，再通过符号重放进行语法推断；NetLifter 则需要带标注的 C／LLVM 输入，通过静态分析推导文法和跨字段约束。不能假定它们获得了相同证据并据此公平排名。它们也有不同盲点：未执行的路径、人工函数定位、实现忽略的字段，以及循环或校验和近似。模糊测试效果提升说明某项下游应用有价值，并不能证明已经重建完整且可互通的端点。[[paper-binpre]] [[paper-icepre]] [[paper-netlifter]]

paragraphs.en: State-machine learning asks which sequences of messages lead to distinguishable responses. StateInspector combines active queries with runtime memory evidence, whereas BLE automata learning interacts with physical devices through a predefined set of abstract protocol actions. Both illustrate that state coverage depends on what the harness can send, how outputs are abstracted, and how reset, timing and nondeterminism are handled. These methods do not automatically recover unknown message syntax. Conversely, format inference does not supply an entire state machine. Bringing the two together remains a research problem: a format-valid message can be inappropriate in a particular state, while an omitted input can hide a whole branch of behavior. [[paper-stateinspector]] [[paper-ble-automata-learning]] [[paper-netplier]]
paragraphs.zh: 状态机学习研究哪些报文序列会产生可区分的响应。StateInspector 将主动查询与运行时内存证据结合；BLE 自动机学习则通过预先定义的一组抽象协议动作与真实设备交互。二者都说明，状态覆盖取决于测试框架能发送什么、如何抽象输出，以及如何处理复位、时序和非确定性。这些方法不会自动恢复未知报文语法；反过来，格式推断也不会提供完整状态机。如何连接二者仍是研究问题：格式有效的报文可能不适合某个状态，而遗漏一种输入可能掩盖整条行为分支。[[paper-stateinspector]] [[paper-ble-automata-learning]] [[paper-netplier]]

title.en: Agent benchmarks: tasks and access conditions
title.zh: 智能体基准：任务与访问条件

paragraphs.en: Agent benchmarks make the allowed investigation process part of the task. CrackMeBench asks for executable-checked solutions to compact binary challenges under a shell interface and a time budget. CREBench separates cryptographic recognition, extraction, wrapper reconstruction and flag recovery. An accepted input, a recovered parameter and a replacement wrapper are different deliverables. Success on these controlled tasks is evidence about those deliverables, rather than recovery of an entire application or arbitrary protected binary. [[paper-crackmebench]] [[paper-crebench]]
paragraphs.zh: 智能体基准把允许的调查过程纳入任务定义。CrackMeBench 在 shell 接口和时间预算下，要求对小型二进制挑战提交可由执行检查的解答。CREBench 则区分密码算法识别、信息提取、包装程序重建和标志恢复。被接受的输入、恢复的参数及替代包装程序，是不同的交付物。在这些受控任务上成功，提供的是关于相应交付物的证据，而非恢复完整应用或任意受保护二进制的证明。[[paper-crackmebench]] [[paper-crebench]]

paragraphs.en: SRE-Bench uses privately authored programs and protected variants to address contamination, with access through an evaluation service rather than a public task release. Its contamination controls remain an attributed methodology. Humans vs. Machines studies static understanding and navigation without dynamic execution; its larger binary-representation study measures context capacity, not challenge-solving accuracy. Prior source exposure and interface restrictions therefore matter when interpreting human–agent comparisons, independently of the model name. [[paper-sre-bench]] [[paper-humans-machines-sre]]
paragraphs.zh: SRE-Bench 使用私有编写的程序及其受保护变体处理数据污染问题，通过评测服务提供访问，而非公开发布任务；污染控制仍是作者所述的方法。Humans vs. Machines 在不进行动态执行的条件下研究静态理解与导航，其规模更大的二进制表示研究测量的是上下文容量，而非挑战求解准确率。因此，解读人类与智能体的比较时，除模型名称外，还需考虑先前源码接触和接口限制。[[paper-sre-bench]] [[paper-humans-machines-sre]]

paragraphs.en: ProgramBench takes another route: agents query a reference executable and consult documentation, while binary inspection, decompilation and internet access are forbidden during inference. Generated tests evaluate the replacement program over finite inputs. Comparisons across agent studies should record tool permissions, query and resource budgets, test visibility and prior exposure, then align the required submission. Rebuilding behavior from black-box queries is not the same task as identifying a secret, explaining static code or recovering source through disassembly. [[paper-programbench]]
paragraphs.zh: ProgramBench 采用另一条路线：智能体查询参考可执行程序并查阅文档，但在推断期间禁止二进制检查、反编译和互联网访问。生成测试在有限输入上评估替代程序。跨智能体研究的比较应记录工具权限、查询和资源预算、测试可见性及先前接触情况，再对齐要求提交的产物。根据黑盒查询重建行为，与识别秘密、解释静态代码或通过反汇编恢复源码，并不是同一任务。[[paper-programbench]]

title.en: Representative studies and their evaluation boundaries
title.zh: 代表性研究及其评测边界

paragraphs.en: The table compares study designs, not scores. Each row identifies what the method receives, what it produces, how the output is assessed and one boundary needed to interpret the assessment. Observation access, original context and human assistance belong in the comparison alongside the algorithm. The selected studies span the six domains and illustrate several method families; they are not a representative sample for estimating field-wide success.
paragraphs.zh: 下表比较研究设计，而非分数。每行说明方法获得什么、生成什么、如何评估输出，以及解释该评估所需的一项边界。观察权限、原始上下文和人工协助，应与算法一同纳入比较。所选研究跨越六个领域，展示若干方法类别，但不是用于估计整个领域成功率的代表性样本。

title.en: Project cases: what the checks establish
title.zh: 项目案例：检查能够确立什么

paragraphs.en: Perfect Dark and Super Mario 64 offer comparatively precise output checks: version-specific ROM digests. Yet comparison depends on the build mode. Perfect Dark separates matching IDO builds from nonmatching GCC builds; sm64 disables comparison for some configurations, including iQue in the reviewed CI. A successful build therefore cannot substitute for an enabled, passing comparison. Both require original assets, and Perfect Dark also reuses extracted boot code. Matching does not establish that every output byte was newly reconstructed. [[perfect-dark-matching-decomp-case]] [[sm64-decomp-case]]
paragraphs.zh: Perfect Dark 与 Super Mario 64 提供了相对精确的输出检查：针对特定版本的 ROM 摘要。但比较是否成立取决于构建模式。Perfect Dark 区分 IDO 一致性构建与不保证匹配的 GCC 构建；sm64 对某些配置关闭比较，包括所审 CI 中的 iQue。因此，构建成功不能替代已启用且通过的比较检查。两者都需要原始素材，Perfect Dark 还复用提取的启动代码。输出匹配不表示每个字节都由新重建的内容产生。[[perfect-dark-matching-decomp-case]] [[sm64-decomp-case]]

paragraphs.en: Pocket Tasks instead checks named editing, persistence and replay behaviors. Its overlapping checker and replay sessions cannot be added as independent observations, and disclosed prior source access precludes a blind-reconstruction interpretation. Open Scrantic tests selected engine properties but can skip data-dependent checks; its headless completion test is not original-frame comparison. Deliberate differences may be useful engineering choices, provided they are reported rather than counted as exact recovery. [[pocket-tasks-reconstruction-case]] [[open-scrantic-screensaver-case]]
paragraphs.zh: Pocket Tasks 检查的是列明的编辑、持久保存和回放行为。其检查器与回放会话存在重叠，不能相加作为独立观察；已披露的先前源码接触也不支持将其解释为盲重建。Open Scrantic 测试部分引擎性质，但依赖数据的检查可能跳过；无界面运行的完成检查不等于与原版画面比较。刻意引入的差异可以是有用的工程选择，但应明确报告，不能计作精确恢复。[[pocket-tasks-reconstruction-case]] [[open-scrantic-screensaver-case]]

paragraphs.en: The rauchg.com case infers a Next.js project from browser-delivered React Server Component (Flight) data. Its reported comparison across 18 routes checks normalized component trees and module references, excluding CSS. A pass does not verify rendered pixels, database writes or unobserved routes. BaoCut Slides supplies an interactive editor and local storage, but its tests do not compare it against the original Claude Slides. Some BaoCut tests use simulated dependencies or skip when the slide compiler has not been built. [[rauchg-rsc-reconstruction-case]] [[baocut-slides-editor-case]]
paragraphs.zh: rauchg.com 案例根据浏览器收到的 React Server Component（Flight）数据推导 Next.js 项目。其报告的 18 路由比较检查规范化组件树和模块引用，不包括 CSS。通过检查不代表渲染像素、数据库写入或未观察路由已经验证。BaoCut Slides 提供交互式编辑器及本地存储，但其测试没有与原版 Claude Slides 进行比较。部分 BaoCut 测试使用模拟依赖，或在尚未构建幻灯片编译器时跳过。[[rauchg-rsc-reconstruction-case]] [[baocut-slides-editor-case]]

paragraphs.en: These cases separate interface structure, visual appearance, interaction and persistent state. None entails recovery of hidden server source. Behavior-oriented research can add dependent workflow replay, as in ProgramDistill, while still leaving untested database invariants and visual fidelity unresolved. The evaluation should name which layer it observes. [[paper-programdistill]]
paragraphs.zh: 这些案例提示应分别讨论界面结构、视觉外观、交互和持久状态；其中任何一项都不蕴含隐藏服务器源码的恢复。面向行为的研究可加入相互依赖的工作流回放，例如 ProgramDistill，但未测试的数据库不变量与视觉一致性仍可能未解决。评测应明确它实际观察的是哪一层。[[paper-programdistill]]

paragraphs.en: NJFE’s camera-to-desktop bridge sends JPEG frames over custom USB serial transport; it does not provide a standard USB webcam (UVC) interface or recover the original camera application. It reuses the earlier otoscope protocol implementation, while the author credits Claude Code with implementation assistance. TCLimate checks selected cloud-reported states after commands; confirmation does not independently demonstrate compressor or airflow behavior. Reported coverage is limited to the documented region and devices, and does not establish support for other regions or models. [[njfe-ear-camera-bridge-case]] [[tclimate-cloud-controls-case]]
paragraphs.zh: NJFE 的摄像头到桌面桥接通过定制 USB 串口传输 JPEG 帧，不提供标准 USB 摄像头（UVC）接口，也没有恢复原始摄像头应用。它复用此前的 otoscope 协议实现，作者则将实现辅助归因于 Claude Code。TCLimate 在发送命令后检查部分云端上报状态；确认结果并不独立证明压缩机或气流的实际行为。报告的覆盖限于文档中的地区与设备，不能据此确立对其他地区或机型的支持。[[njfe-ear-camera-bridge-case]] [[tclimate-cloud-controls-case]]

paragraphs.en: An acceptance check defines the scope of a result. If candidates are selected using the same finite tests later reported as success, held-out checks are especially valuable: SLaDe, for example, selects the first I/O-passing beam candidate within the original calling context. That is stronger than compilation alone, but weaker than all-input equivalence. [[paper-slade]]
paragraphs.zh: 验收检查决定结果的适用范围。若使用同一组有限测试选择候选，并将这些测试的通过率报告为成功，独立保留的检查尤其有价值。例如，SLaDe 在原始调用上下文中选择首个通过输入／输出测试的束搜索候选。这比仅能编译更有力，但弱于全部输入上的等价性。[[paper-slade]]

paragraphs.en: Attribution requires a separate record of what the human, model, prior project and reference system supplied. Open Scrantic explicitly names REA and Claude Code; BaoCut’s support for agent engines does not identify which model produced its adaptation. Reused assets, pre-existing protocol logic and prior source exposure must remain visible. Likewise, a code license does not transfer rights to original ROMs, fonts or hosted services. These dependencies affect reproducibility as well as interpretation. [[open-scrantic-screensaver-case]] [[baocut-slides-editor-case]]
paragraphs.zh: 归因还需单独记录人工、模型、先前项目和参考系统分别提供了什么。Open Scrantic 明确提及 REA 与 Claude Code；BaoCut 支持智能体引擎，并不说明具体由哪个模型产生了改编实现。复用素材、既有协议逻辑及先前源码接触都应保持可见。同样，代码许可不转移原 ROM、字体或托管服务的权利。这些依赖同时影响可复现性与结果解读。[[open-scrantic-screensaver-case]] [[baocut-slides-editor-case]]

paragraphs.en: These reports are also insufficient for causal claims about agent productivity. A reconstruction may combine human analysis, inherited implementations, generated code and target-specific fixes. Without comparable baselines and recorded interventions, success cannot be assigned to one model or tool. Future studies should separate discovery effort from implementation effort, report failed attempts and resource budgets, and distinguish assistance during reconstruction from agent functionality merely supported by the finished application.
paragraphs.zh: 这些报告同样不足以支持有关智能体生产效率的因果结论。一项重建可能结合人工分析、既有实现、生成代码及针对目标的修正。缺少可比基线和干预记录时，不能将成功归因于单一模型或工具。后续研究应分别记录查明目标机制与编写重建实现所需的工作量，报告失败尝试和资源预算，并区分重建期间的智能体辅助与成品应用仅仅支持的智能体功能。

paragraphs.en: The literature and case comparisons suggest an agenda centered on evidence that can distinguish competing reconstructions. The following questions concern evaluation design and reporting, rather than promised improvements from a particular model.
paragraphs.zh: 文献与案例比较提示，应围绕能够区分不同重建方案的证据制定研究议程。以下问题关注评测设计与报告方式，而非承诺某个模型能够带来的改进。

bullets.en: Can versioned, held-out traces test unseen sequences, errors and restarts without exposing their expectations during reconstruction? Publish validator changes separately from candidate changes.
bullets.zh: 能否用有版本记录、独立保留的轨迹测试未见过的操作序列、错误和重启，同时不在重建期间暴露期望值？应分别发布验证器与候选实现的变更。

bullets.en: Can evaluations distinguish reused assets and code from newly inferred behavior, and report source exposure and human interventions alongside model identity and tool versions?
bullets.zh: 评测能否区分复用的素材／代码与新推导的行为，并在模型身份和工具版本之外，同时报告源码接触情况及人工干预？

bullets.en: Can tests independently observe physical effects, durable state and visual output, instead of relying on one successful API response or structural comparison?
bullets.zh: 测试能否独立观察物理效果、持久状态及视觉输出，而非仅依赖一次成功的 API 响应或结构比较？

bullets.en: Can small redistributable fixtures expose skipped checks, unsupported versions and deliberate deviations, enabling replication without distributing proprietary assets or assuming access to mutable cloud services?
bullets.zh: 能否通过可再分发的小型测试样本，明确展示被跳过的检查、不支持的版本及刻意差异，使复现无需分发专有素材，也不假设始终能访问可变的云服务？

bullets.en: How much of a reconstruction survives a new target version, device variant or compiler setting? Report regressions separately from adaptation work, with the original acceptance conditions retained.
bullets.zh: 目标版本、设备变体或编译器设置改变后，重建成果有多少仍然成立？应保留原验收条件，将回归问题与适配工作分别报告。

paragraphs.en: This is a purposive editorial synthesis of a fixed collection, not a systematic review or a pooled performance analysis. The source records cover different publication stages, artifact revisions and degrees of access. Documentary inspection supports the distinctions discussed here but does not replace experiment reproduction. The selected cases expose methodological contrasts; their frequency in this survey says nothing about how common or successful those approaches are in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 本综述是对固定合集进行的有目的的编辑性综合，并非系统综述或汇总性能分析。来源记录涉及不同发表阶段、产物修订和访问程度。文档检查能够支持这里讨论的区分，但不能替代实验复现。所选案例用于展示方法上的对比，其在本综述中出现的频率，并不说明这些方法在实践中有多常见或多成功。

paragraphs.en: Across the six domains, reconstruction is best understood through the relationship between evidence, intended output and acceptance oracle. The practical value of an approximation can be substantial even when its claim is narrow. Explicit input access, reuse, version boundaries and test coverage make that value easier to assess. A shared reporting framework can connect work on interfaces, code, behavior and environments while preserving the distinctions that give each result its meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 在六个领域中，通过证据、预期输出与验收判据之间的关系，可以更恰当地理解重建。即使主张范围有限，近似实现仍可能具有重要实践价值。明确输入权限、复用情况、版本边界和测试覆盖，有助于判断这种价值。共同的报告框架可以连接界面、代码、行为与环境方面的研究，同时保留赋予各项结果意义的差异。
